lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters posterior to the pectoral fin region. Clusters are organized into approximately 10 visible vertical columns and 4-5 horizontal rows, with inter-cluster distance decreasing towards the posterior of the flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs, forming a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with light-reflecting edges superiorly and shadowed troughs inferiorly.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-density distribution of small, high-luminance blobs scattered across the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, with higher concentration toward the posterior edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: High-luminance irregular patch visible on the leading distal edge of the right pectoral fin, suggestive of minor tissue abrasion.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple small, elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (commensal organisms) clustered near the ventral surface and pectoral fin.
